info.title: Get Shop SKU Performance Detail
info.description: Returns performance metrics for the specified SKU.

get.description: Returns performance metrics for the specified SKU.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: start_date_ge
parameters.description: Start time (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, inclusive.

parameters.name: end_date_lt
parameters.description: End time (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, exclusive.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description:
Granularity of the data.
Available values: ALL, 1D
Default value: ALL
* ALL: aggregate
* 1D: daily

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description:
Currency:
- USD: US dollars
- LOCAL (default): Local currency where the shop is located

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

latest_available_date.description: Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).

product_id.description: The ID of the product that the SKU belongs to.

sku_id.description: The ID of the SKU for this performance object.

start_date.description: Start date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, inclusive.

end_date.description: End date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, exclusive.

amount.description: GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

gmv.description: Overall Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for the SKU.

amount.description: GMV amount for the corresponding type and currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

type.description:
GMV breakdown type.
Possible values:
- LIVE: Live stream content.
- VIDEO: Video content.
- PRODUCT_CARD: Product card.

items_sold.description: Number of units sold for the SKU.

amount.description: Number of units sold for the corresponding type.

type.description:
Items-sold breakdown type.
Possible values:
- LIVE: Live stream content.
- VIDEO: Video content.
- PRODUCT_CARD: Product card.

sku_orders.description: Total (sum of all) orders for the SKU.

intervals.description: Interval data for the requested time range. The time range of each interval is determined by the granularity.

performance.description: Overall performance data for the product.
